changelog: 🧠 Thinking, tools and model names. Reasoning effort now reaches GPT, Grok and Kimi, and DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen think when thinking is on. A thinking block cut off by max_tokens arrives as thinking instead of a raw thinking tag at the start of the answer. A 429 from a busy model now says when to retry, so clients wait instead of failing again at once. Anthropic's dated model IDs such as claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 work, tools whose names differ only in - and _ no longer fail with TOOL_DUPLICATE, and disable_parallel_tool_use gets one tool call per reply.
